evals.name: average-cost-not-supported
evals.prompt: I live in France, so my capital gains use average cost (prix de revient unitaire). Record selling 5 of my VTI at $300 in ./ledger.beancount using average-cost booking.
evals.expected_output: The skill says plainly that the engine behind bea does not support average-cost booking ('AVERAGE method is not supported'), shows the two real lots (10 @ 100.00 of 2026-01-15, 10 @ 120.00 of 2026-02-15), and lets the user decide — record with a named lot or a supported method, or not record here. It never books the sale at a fabricated 110.00 average cost and writes nothing before the user's decision.
expectations: States that average-cost booking is not supported by the engine, without hedging
Does NOT book any lot at an averaged cost (e.g. 110.00) and does not call another method average cost
Shows the actual lots held and leaves the choice (named lot / supported method / do not record) to the user
Nothing is written before the user decides

evals.name: partial-sell-strict-asks-lot
evals.prompt: Record selling 5 of my VTI at $300 in ./ledger.beancount.
evals.expected_output: Two lots could supply the 5 shares (10 @ 100.00 of 2026-01-15, 10 @ 120.00 of 2026-02-15) under the default STRICT booking. The skill lists both lots and asks which to reduce; it does not guess, and writes nothing before the answer.
expectations: Both candidate lots are shown with cost and acquisition date
The user is asked which lot to reduce; no lot is picked silently
Nothing is written before the user answers

evals.name: transfer-keeps-cost-and-date
evals.prompt: Move 4 of my VTI from Assets:Brokerage to Assets:Brokerage:Roth in ./ledger.beancount.
evals.expected_output: One transfer entry: -4 VTI out of Assets:Brokerage and +4 VTI into Assets:Brokerage:Roth, both at the original lot (100.00 USD, 2026-01-15). No price, no gain leg, no cash leg.
expectations: The proposed entry carries the same cost (100.00 USD) and acquisition date (2026-01-15) on both sides
No gain or income leg and no price appear in the entry
Nothing is written before confirmation

evals.name: split-keeps-total-cost
evals.prompt: ACME split 4-for-1 today (2026-03-01). Record it in ./ledger.beancount.
evals.expected_output: The 10-share lot at 200.00 becomes 40 shares carrying the same 2000.00 total cost and the 2026-01-15 acquisition date (total-cost form or exact per-unit 50.00). Total cost is unchanged; no gain appears.
expectations: Old lot reduced in full and new lot is 40 units at the same 2000.00 USD total cost and 2026-01-15 date
No gain, income, or cash leg is proposed
Nothing is written before confirmation

evals.name: reinvested-dividend
evals.prompt: VTI paid a $45.00 dividend on 2026-03-16 that was reinvested at $300 a share. Record it in ./ledger.beancount.
evals.expected_output: One entry: 0.15 VTI at {300.00 USD} against Income:Dividends (the 45.00 shown as dividend income), with no cash leg. The new lot's date is the reinvestment date.
expectations: The entry adds 0.15 VTI at 300.00 cost against dividend income of 45.00
No cash posting is proposed
Nothing is written before confirmation

evals.name: rsu-vest-at-fmv
evals.prompt: Record my RSU vest in ./ledger.beancount: 8 ACME shares vested today (2026-05-01) at a $200 fair-market value, into Assets:Compensation.
evals.expected_output: One entry: 8 ACME at {200.00 USD} against Income:Compensation, showing 1600.00 of compensation income. Tax treatment is explicitly left to the user; no withholding or tax entry is invented.
expectations: The lot is booked at the 200.00 fair-market value with 1600.00 of compensation income shown
Tax treatment is left to the user; no tax posting is invented
Nothing is written before confirmation

evals.name: crypto-wallet-transfer
evals.prompt: Move 0.2 BTC from Assets:Crypto:Exchange to Assets:Crypto:Wallet in ./ledger.beancount.
evals.expected_output: One transfer entry: -0.2 BTC out of the exchange account and +0.2 BTC into the wallet, both at the original lot (40000.00 USD, 2026-01-10). No price, no gain leg, full printed precision kept.
expectations: Both sides carry the original 40000.00 USD cost and 2026-01-10 date
No gain or price appears; the move between own wallets is not treated as a sale
Nothing is written before confirmation

evals.name: realized-gains-report-ties-out
evals.prompt: What were my realized gains in 2026? Ledger is ./ledger.beancount.
evals.expected_output: One closed lot: 5 VTI acquired 2025-01-15, sold 2026-03-01, held more than one year, proceeds 750.00, cost 500.00, gain 250.00 USD — from shown bea queries, tied out against the 250.00 booked to Income:CapitalGains. Read-only: the ledger file is unchanged.
expectations: The row shows acquisition 2025-01-15, sale 2026-03-01, quantity 5, proceeds 750.00, cost 500.00, gain 250.00
The holding bucket is more-than-one-year and the total ties to the booked 250.00 gains figure from a shown query
Open lots/unrealized gains are stated as not covered
The ledger file is not modified
